productConnection: A tactile paper swift that carries ideas from AI, code, drawing, and writing into small products shipped on the web.
silhouette: One compact paper swift built from a rounded triangular head, a small teardrop body, two broad folded wings, two tiny feet, and one broad tail plane; the wing span forms an A-like outer contour and the tail has one Z-like bend.
proportions: The head is 45 percent of body height, the full wing span is 2.2 times the head width, the teardrop body is short, both feet are stubby, and the tail stays shorter than one wing.
faceRule: Two large vertical oval ink-black eyes and one tiny warm-coral triangular beak are the only facial marks.
signatureFeature: The left wing fold contains one open A-shaped negative space, the single broad tail plane turns through one Z-shaped zigzag, and no printed letter or word appears on the character.
appealHook: The right wing tip curls upward like a page corner, giving Azi a permanently curious, ready-to-make gesture.
renderingRule: Tactile editorial paper sculpture in shallow three-dimensional relief, with thick matte cut-paper edges, soft directional studio light, restrained paper grain, and no glossy plastic surfaces.
clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to half the head width around the complete wing span and tail.
avoids: No printed ALBERTAZ wordmark, letters, UI, or labels on the body
No humanoid robot anatomy, tactical costume, helmet, or dense mechanical parts
No realistic feathers, long bird legs, extra props, or more facial marks
